title: Alias Script — OnAliasInit
content:
- Event OnAliasInit()
    Event received when this alias has been filled (or not filled) as a result of the quest starting up.

title: Alias Script — OnAliasReset
content:
- Event OnAliasReset()
    Event received when this alias is reset (usually when the quest the alias is attached to starts up, assuming the quest is repeatable).

title: Alias Script — OnAliasShutdown
content:
- Event OnAliasShutdown()
    Event received when the parent quest for this alias shuts down (and the alias has been emptied).

Notes:
- This object is often confused with ReferenceAlias Script. You probably mean to be using that.

title: Alias Script (section 1)
content:
Extends: ScriptObject

Native base script for every alias in the game.

Definition:
ScriptName Alias extends ScriptObject Native Hidden

Properties:
None

Global Functions:
None

Member Functions:
- Quest Function GetOwningQuest()
    Returns the Quest that owns this alias.

- Function StartObjectProfiling()
    Starts profiling all scripts attached to this alias.

- Function StopObjectProfiling()
    Stops profiling all scripts attached to this alias.

Events:

- Event OnAliasInit()
    Event received when this alias has been filled (or not filled) as a result of the quest starting up.

- Event OnAliasReset()
    Event received when this alias is reset (usually when the quest the alias is attached to starts up, assuming the quest is repeatable).

- Event OnAliasShutdown()
    Event received when the parent quest for this alias shuts down (and the alias has been emptied).

Notes:
- This object is often confused with ReferenceAlias Script. You probably mean to be using that.
